subject.title: fix: prevent empty Telegram sends for cron summaries

question: Should the generic direct-delivery fallback metadata remain a supported plugin-SDK contract for channel adapters, rather than an implementation detail limited to the Telegram extension?
rationale: The branch exports new helpers from the plugin SDK so external adapters can consume cron delivery fallback text; repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Keep the two generic fallback helpers public, with the existing focused contract coverage, so channel adapters can own their own sendability semantics.

options.title: Use a different approved adapter seam
options.body: Redesign the handoff before merge if maintainers do not want cron fallback metadata to become part of the plugin-SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the two generic fallback helpers public, with the existing focused contract coverage, so channel adapters can own their own sendability semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work established the relevant Telegram outbound-adapter normalization boundary.
